subject: BlueBridge discovery — next meeting options & evaluation kickoff
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@bluebridge.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: BlueBridge discovery — next meeting options & evaluation kickoff

Thanks again for taking the time today, Alicia. Quick recap from our call and a couple of concrete next steps so we can lock the calendar: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary goal: accurate claims extraction + entity linking into BlueBridge pipeline for downstream analytics.
- Key success metrics you mentioned: 95% extraction accuracy on key fields, <200ms median latency for single-record lookups, and clear error-rate targets for edge-case docs.
- Data sensitivity: mix of redacted and limited-PII samples; security and retention are blockers for procurement.

Proposed next meetings
1) Product demo / technical deep dive (45–60 min) — show ingestion, prompt engineering for extraction, latency/throughput numbers, and integration touchpoints.
2) Evaluation kickoff (30–45 min) — align trial plan, success criteria, prompt set, sample dataset upload and timeline.

I have two open slots next week — would either work for you?
- Tue, Mar 16 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Mar 18 — 13:30–14:30 PT (we can also do 14:00 if you prefer)

Suggested attendees
- BlueBridge: Alicia (you), Tom Hsu (Eng), someone from security/procurement (if available)
- Redwood: me (AE), Neha Kapoor (Solutions Eng), Ben Carter (Customer Success); Karthik can join the technical breakout if deep infra questions come up.

Prework / asks before the demo
- A short list (3–5) of representative documents + a sample JSON schema of the fields you want extracted (PII can be redacted).
- Any non-negotiable compliance constraints (e.g., retention windows, encryption requirements).

I attached our quick discovery notes and a pilot template to make it easy to sketch a trial plan. If one of the proposed slots works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Attachments: BlueBridge_Discovery_Notes.pdf (pdf), BlueBridge_Pilot_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the clear recap and the proposed slots. Thu, Mar 18 works well for us. Could we shift to 13:30 PT (1:30pm) instead of 14:00/14:30? That gives Tom time to join after his standup.

Quick notes from our side:
- We’ll put together a small set of sample documents (redacted) and a short description of the output schema you asked for — expect those in the next 48 hours.
- Security is a concern for procurement. Can you include a brief SOC 2 / data-handling summary in the follow-up? That will speed internal approvals.
- For the evaluation kickoff, we’ll want to include our data lead and one person from procurement if possible — I’ll loop them in as the timing firm ups.

Tom (cc) will coordinate any engineering questions. 

See you on Thu 3/18 at 13:30 PT.

Best,
Alicia

Perfect — I’ve booked Thu, Mar 18 at 13:30 PT and sent a calendar invite (accept to add to your calendar). Agenda and logistics below: 

Demo / Technical deep dive (45 min) — Thu, Mar 18, 13:30–14:15 PT
- 13:30–13:40: quick intros and success criteria recap (Marcus / Alicia)
- 13:40–14:00: Neha — ingestion pipeline, prompt templates, and live extraction demo on a redacted sample
- 14:00–14:10: Karthik — infra/latency targets, quantization/throughput options, and deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
- 14:10–14:15: Next steps and evaluation kickoff scheduling (Ben / Marcus)

Evaluation kickoff (suggested follow-up) — propose the week of Mar 22 for a short alignment meeting to finalize trial plan and success metrics. I attached a draft trial plan (BB_trial_plan.xlsx) and a short SOC2 summary for procurement.

Prework checklist (please upload to the Drive link below before Thu):
- 3–5 representative documents (redacted)
- Desired output schema or a sample CSV of expected fields
- Rough daily volume / throughput expectations (docs/day, avg tokens per doc)

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/bluebridge/BB_trial_plan.xlsx
HubSpot: HB-98765

Attachments: BB_trial_plan.xlsx (xlsx), SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)

If anything changes on your side (attendees or the sample data), let us know and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to the demo.

—Marcus

Hi Alicia / Marcus — quick note from the solutions-eng side: I’ll lead the technical deep dive on Thu and focus on the sections below. Happy to adjust based on what you upload.

Planned demo highlights
- Ingestion and normalization: how we handle varied claim formats and map to canonical fields
- Prompt templates: the two patterns we’ll test (instruction-based extraction + few-shot verifier)
- KV cache + batching behavior for latency-sensitive lookups
- Integration patterns: webhook callbacks vs direct S3/DB writes

Pre-demo asks (short list)
- Redacted sample set (3 documents) and one example of a complex edge case
- Desired SLA targets (p99/p95 latency, throughput) and expected daily volume

I attached a short eval prework checklist for folks to follow — it makes the kickoff much faster. If Alicia can share the documents to the Drive link before Wed EOD, we’ll be able to run the live extraction in the demo.

Attachment: eval_prework_checklist.md (md)

See you Thursday — Neha
